Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Medicine MBChB at University of Bristol

What University of Bristol asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Bristol courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 4 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not generally required — Bristol does not generally require standardised tests (Law requires LNAT; Medicine requires UCAT)
  • SAT (evidence-based reading and writing section only) at 650+ or ACT at 28+ may count as one of the three additional qualifications needed alongside the diploma (GPA 3.2 minimum, 3.4 for competitive courses)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
English language
  • Bristol English language Profile A
  • IELTS 7.5 overall with 7.0 in all skills
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 103 overall with R24, L22, S25, W24 (tests up to 20 Jan 2026)
    • 5.5 overall, 5 in all skills (tests from 21 Jan 2026)
  • Pearson PTE Academic 78 overall with no lower than 71 in all skills
  • GCSE English Language grade B/6 also accepted

Required if English is not the applicant’s first language.

Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: MB ChB Medicine (2027 entry) · Bristol: English language Profile A
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required for all applicants, taken in the same calendar year as the UCAS application
  • No UCAT cut-off score; applicants meeting the academic requirements are ranked 100% on UCAT (excluding Situational Judgement) for interview
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Medicine
Subject prerequisites
  • Required:
    • Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics (A level) — the one-of choice is display-only
    • the engine holds Chemistry only
  • GCSE: Mathematics at 7/A and English at 4/C

The second required subject is a one-of choice the engine cannot express; only Chemistry is coded.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams at grades 4, 4, 4
    • Minimum GPA 3.2
  • Official: US high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) plus three additional qualifications — AP tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5), AP classes over two semesters, Honors classes, dual-enrolment courses, SAT/ACT, IB Higher Level courses or A levels

Official (2027 entry): high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) and three additional qualifications; AP tests count at a score of at least 4 (more commonly 5). Bristol does not say which courses count as competitive, and APs are one of several qualification types that can make up the three.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Interview required:
    • top-scoring applicants (by UCAT) are invited to online interviews, anticipated December–February
    • no offer without attending an interview except in exceptional circumstances
  • Personal statement is not a weighted part of selection
  • Minimum age: 18 by 1 September in the year of entry
  • Offers subject to DBS check, occupational health clearance and MSC Excluded Students Database check
  • Work experience is not required but strongly encouraged
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Medicine
